name: shoulder lateral rotation (external rotation)
description: Rotating the upper arm outward, which works the rotator cuff muscles at the back of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm outward, keeping the elbow tucked against your side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
